title: Modpack Used By Poldo_TMG
description: Modpack used by Poldo_TMG - Contains immersive and realistic mods for servers or other.
body:
![Expritan's Castle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5bc13be8c0e22dcce6d6eaffd7aab5ffeca0e61a.png)

🌹The modpack makes the gameplay more immersive, realistic, and with various textures and shaders to apply as you like. There are a lot of things that make the game lighter and also less annoying in some aspects, or that make the game more fun.🖤

Features:

🌹3 Shaders🖤

🌹Ottimizatio🖤

🌹Full Bright🖤

🌹Voice Chat🖤

🌹WorldEdit🖤

🌹Axiom🖤

🌹Better Lanterns🖤

🌹3D Skins Layers🖤

🌹Animated Items🖤

🌹Low Fire🖤

🌹Better Sky🖤

🌹Purple Texture Pack🖤
